hook.excerpt: Central Africa, bordering the Atlantic Ocean at the Equator, between Republic of the Congo and Equatorial Guinea || narrow coastal plain; hilly interior; savanna in east and south || the country has maintained its pristine rain forest and rich biodiversity || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, diamond, niobium, manganese, uranium, gold, timber, iron ore, hydropower || Exports: crude petroleum, ships, manganese ore, refined petroleum, wood (2023)

economy.excerpt: natural-resource-rich, upper-middle-income, Central African economy; significant reliance on oil and mineral exports; highly urbanized population; high levels of poverty and unemployment; uncertainty on institutional and development reform progress following 2023 military coup || Exports: crude petroleum, ships, manganese ore, refined petroleum, wood (2023) || Industries: petroleum extraction and refining; manganese, gold; chemicals, ship repair, food and beverages, textiles, lumbering and plywood, cement
